newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 19.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 19.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow industrials fell 139 points, or 1.89 percent, to 7195 on renewed fears that the Federal Reserve will raise short term interest rates at its policy meeting on Tuesday.

* Supporters of Indonesia's ruling Golkar and a rival Moslem-oriented party clashed in several areas of Jakarta on Sunday as a second day of campaign violence ahead of May 29 elections hit the capital.
The Indonesian capital Jakarta was quiet on Monday after a weekend of clashes in the city between rival partisans campaigning for the May 29 elections, witnesses said.
* On Friday, the Jakarta composite index rose 0.09 points to close at 657.07 points.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,443.00/45.00 at 0210 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,434.00/36.00.
* Salt producer Fiskaragung and retailer Matahari on announcements of higher first quarter results.
* Footwear maker Kasogi on reports of a proposed rights issue and possible link-up with Brazilian footwear firm.
* Pulp and rayon maker Indorayon on reports of the proposed acquisition of a foreign fibre firm and a local chemical firm.
* Sorini and Aneka Kimia on renewed market talk of a possible merger.
